scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && pnpm run test:repo
scripts.verify: pnpm run ci && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.verify:utils: pnpm run ci && pnpm --filter @adriangalilea/utils run verify && pnpm run test:repo
scripts.verify:llm: pnpm run ci && pnpm --filter @adriangalilea/llm run verify && pnpm run test:repo
scripts.verify:bot: pnpm run ci && pnpm --filter @adriangalilea/bot run verify && pnpm run test:repo
scripts.verify:metrics: pnpm run ci && pnpm --filter @adriangalilea/metrics run verify && pnpm run test:repo
